items.title: Frank Foster — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I’m certain he knew a gentleman by the name of Jimmy Guy who was a trombone player who had been a member of the Wilberforce Collegians.

ctx.x: I’m certain he knew a gentleman by the name of Jimmy Guy who was a trombone player who had been a member of the Wilberforce Collegians. What was your dad’s name?
William A. Brower, Sr. He’s from High Point [North Carolina]. Same street as Trane [John Coltrane], which is another thing.
